verdicts.why: 'to manage' is the lemma of the 'able to' that the seed renders as 'wouldn't have been able to'; the row is about its sentence.
असं is the particle in LEGO L2 'असं ज्याने कोणी म्हटलं => whoever said'; the seed target 'Whoever said it would be...' does not render 'that'.
The seed has the contraction "you'll forget"; 'will forget' is the uncontracted form, and 'forget' alone would change the gloss.
'suspicion' is the noun form of 'I suspect' in the seed, and it matches LEGO L1.
'to keep on' glosses the same चालू ठेवणे as the seed's 'keep going', but no single value is forced by the seed.
The seed's "didn't" is a fused negation contraction, so 'not' is not a contiguous substring.
ਕਰ ਰਹੇ ਸੀ is glossed 'were doing' while the seed renders it 'were talking about'; the row is about its sentence, and no fix is forced.
ਤੇ is in the LEGO, but the seed 'consider ten possible problems' has no 'about'.
The seed has the contraction "It's", which is fused with 'it's' in sibling C01.
ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ is a literal gloss of a word the seed 'Badly.' does not render.
ਗਾ is a literal future-suffix gloss of 'will'; the seed renders it as "going to" (C03).
'we met' matches LEGO L2 'we last met'; the seed's 'we last saw each other' is worded differently and no single fix is forced.
'objection not' is a literal gloss of the idiom the seed renders "I don't mind" (LEGO L1).
ਹੁਣ is glossed 'now', but the seed's 'so far' renders the whole ਹੁਣ ਤੱਕ idiom.
The seed has the contraction "What's", which is fused with 'what' in sibling C01.
ਪਵੇਗਾ is glossed 'will have to', but the seed's 'have to' drops the future ('I have to find out').
The row matches its LEGO 'ਕਰਨੀ ਚਾਹੀਦੀ ਹੈ => we must', but the seed target is 'We must work hard to learn...'.
ਵਿੱਚ is part of the ਗੁੱਸੇ ਵਿੱਚ LEGO rendered 'angry'; the seed 'appear angry' has no 'in'.
The LEGO 'ਉਹ ਚਾਹੇ ਤਾਂ ਲੈ ਆ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ' differs from the seed's known sentence (ਉਹ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਉਹ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੀ), and the seed target has no 'bring'.
The LEGO target "it's gotten very late at night" differs from the seed's "It's so late at night".
